title: openrig studio — surface manifest row (contract v0.1)
description: One row in surfaces.json surfaces[]. Stability: fields marked x-stability 'stable' change only additively while the contract is 0.x; 'provisional' fields may change with a minor bump. The runtime validates warn-first: rows failing required checks are excluded from the served rail and named in GET /api/contract manifest.errors[]; unknown fields are warnings, never errors.

id.description: Unique surface id. Used by deep links (?s=<id>) and the open-surface shell message.

name.description: Rail label. Short, uppercase by convention.

path.description: Same-origin path the shell loads in the stage iframe (e.g. /surfaces/mine.html). Exactly one of path or url is required.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL with a non-empty host (e.g. https://host/path) for external surfaces. Exactly one of path or url is required — never both.

hint.description: One-line tooltip shown on the rail tab.

category.description: Grouping hint (create | build | grow | system by convention).

popout.description: Open in a new tab instead of the stage.

hideAgents.description: Suppress the agent-sidebar toggle while this surface is active.

unmountOnBlur.description: Remove the iframe when backgrounded instead of keeping it alive. Required for terminal-style surfaces: a hidden kept-alive client would stay attached and fight visible clients.

railMin.description: Ask the shell to condense its rail while this surface is active.

project.description: Project-view scoping tag; surfaces without it show in every view.

port.description: Multi-process deployments only: the localhost port this surface's own server listens on. Single-runtime deployments use path.

sub.description: Multi-host deployments only: subdomain token for hosted resolution.

samehost.description: Resolve against the shell's own origin in hosted deployments.

hosts.description: Restrict the row to named host classes; omitted = everywhere.

preserve.description: State kinds to keep across a CODE reload — scroll | selection | form | playhead by convention, and the vocabulary is open. The surface declares WHAT to keep; the capture and restore are performed by the runtime helper, so the surface does not implement them. Declaring this does not by itself start a signal loop: see change-signal.md for what the runtime does and does not do with it today.
